version_notes: Baseline Bollinger Band and Awesome Oscillator strategy.
Three-touch Bollinger reversal variant with structural confirmation.
Original symmetric long and short rules with completed H1 trend alignment, M5 reclaim, structural stop, fixed 2R target, and 180-minute exit.
Long-only refinement. Requires the absolute H1 EMA20–EMA50 spread to be at least 1.5 × M5 ATR14; all v1.0 risk and exit rules are retained.
Adds customizable per-session entry and realized-loss limits to the long-only v1.1 rules; defaults to four entries and two losses per New York session.
